project_type: Python FastAPI + React TypeScript football prediction platform
build_system: No build system - Python modules with direct imports
test_framework: pytest with fixtures, 10 walk-forward tests currently pass
verification_instructions: Run pytest on specific test files to verify functionality, check prediction endpoints for HTTP 200 responses
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - all files are source code, no generated artifacts
environment_constraints: sklearn not available (graceful degradation implemented), database contains ~4,543 total matches with ~2,673 finished matches

key_patterns: WalkForwardEvaluator uses temporal safety, CalibrationEngine has sklearn graceful degradation, EnsembleEngine has 3 weighting strategies, all prediction code uses structured dataclasses
